title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
abstract: arXiv:2611.08175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. translated_title: PCBRouteAgent：LLM智能体距离成为PCB布线工程师还有多远？
translated_abstract: 自动化印刷电路板（PCB）布线需要在严格的设计规则约束下协调板级连通性决策与几何执行。尽管近期的智能体已经能够与原生布线工具交互，但在复杂电路板上实现可靠布线仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了PCBRouteAgent，一个受人类工程师协调全局策略与局部执行方式启发的多模态PCB布线智能体。全局布线规划器结合电路板图像以及结构化的电气与几何信息，指定连接拓扑、布线顺序、布线通道和层间转换。详细布线执行器通过KiCad的原生布线引擎实现这些规划指导，并执行有界的局部恢复。未能解决的失败会以结构化反馈的形式返回，在保留已接受布线的同时实现有针对性的规划修订。我们在来自PCBWorld-Bench四个测试子集的247块合成与真实电路板上对PCBRouteAgent进行了评估。
tldr: PCBRouteAgent是一个模仿人类工程师“全局规划+局部执行”协作方式的多模态LLM布线智能体，通过全局布线规划器与基于KiCad的详细布线执行器配合，并利用结构化失败反馈迭代修正规划，在247块电路板上实现了可靠的自动化PCB布线。
